em_level_reasoning: Surgical procedure-only encounter. Patient presented for definitive treatment of chronic recurrent ingrown right hallux toenail. Only the partial nail avulsion with permanent chemical (phenol/alcohol) matrixectomy was performed; no separately identifiable E/M service was documented beyond the work inherent to the procedure. CPT 11750 is the correct code for permanent matrix destruction (vs 11730 simple avulsion or 11765 wedge skin excision). Digital block and local anesthetic are integral to 11750 and not separately reportable. T5 modifier identifies right great toe. 10-day global period applies; modifier -25 not applicable (no E/M billed).
